title: Spartacus No More Doom

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: I AM SPARTACUS AND I... don't know how to thank you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I AM SPARTACUS AND I... don't know how to thank you.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Gone. Done. Floyd deleted it right in front of me. There was this woman there with him...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gone. Done. Floyd deleted it right in front of me. There was this woman there with him...

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: She know what she's getting into?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She know what she's getting into?

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Got a few dreams to unpack.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Got a few dreams to unpack.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: I... I mean, yeah. Yes. I'd like that. So, ahem, I'll see you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I... I mean, yeah. Yes. I'd like that. So, ahem, I'll see you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She's come from Hover Derby. She'll be fine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She's come from Hover Derby. She'll be fine.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She's come from Hover Derby. She'll be fine.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She's come from Hover Derby. She'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's for her to find out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's for her to find out.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's for her to find out.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's for her to find out.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what now? No more Bare Metal. No more mods. You can do anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what now? No more Bare Metal. No more mods. You can do anything.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So what now? No more Bare Metal. No more mods. You can do anything.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So what now? No more Bare Metal. No more mods. You can do anything.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We should go out to celebrate sometime.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We should go out to celebrate sometime.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: We should go out to celebrate sometime.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: We should go out to celebrate sometime.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We can seal the deal right here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We can seal the deal right here.
